documents.subject: Invoice and receipt alignment note
documents.body: Operational review records invoice AP-00062 as posted for 1128.16 USD. The invoice references vendor VEN-002 and purchase order PO-00062. The purchase order records the same amount, and service receipt RC-AP-00062 records an accepted amount of 1128.16 USD for that purchase order. The receipt date and invoice date are both 2025-02-25. Acceptance is recorded under EMP-005. This note documents the available fields only; it does not establish an additional approval, payment, or explanation.
